body.name: responseTypes
body.type: finite stratum-indexed legal latent response-type family
body.def: \(\mathcal R_x\) contains every map \(r=(D^{\mathrm{pot}}(0),D^{\mathrm{pot}}(1),S^{\mathrm{pot}}(0),S^{\mathrm{pot}}(1),Y^{\mathrm{pot}}(0),Y^{\mathrm{pot}}(1))\) satisfying \(D^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)\ge D^{\mathrm{pot}}(0)\); only when \(D^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)>D^{\mathrm{pot}}(0)\) must it also satisfy \(s(x)\{S^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)-S^{\mathrm{pot}}(0)\}\ge0\). Selection responses of never-takers and always-takers are otherwise unrestricted.
body.role: finite latent support implementing complier-conditional selection monotonicity
